thread:
customer_jess: Hey team — after we renamed our tool from `translate_text` -> `translate` this morning, the client started getting 404s: \"tool not found\". This started ~09:03 UTC. No code changes on our side.

support_lee: Sorry about that, Jess. Can you paste the exact request body & the SDK version? Also any request_id from the log would help.

customer_jess: SDK v2.4.1. Example request (sanitized):
```json
{
  "tool_name": "translate_text",
  "args": { "text": "hello", "target": "es" }
}
```
Trace id: rdx-9a1c-0f2e. We saw a mixture: some calls succeed, most fail.

devex_sam: Quick hypothesis: client-side name cache hasn't picked up the rename. v2 SDK caches registry lookups for 10m by default. Are you on a long-lived process that might have cached the old mapping?

customer_jess: We run serverless containers but reuse a warm worker pool. Could be TTL-related. However this feels inconsistent — even fresh containers still hit 404 occasionally.

backend_maya: Pinging the registry. I see a rename event for that tool: `translate_text` -> `translate` applied at 1998760000. Current registry entries (replica query): primary shows alias `translate` -> uuid 7f2b, but replica-2 still returns an entry keyed by `translate_text` -> uuid 7f2b without the `translate` alias. Looks like partial propagation.

registry-bot: rename_event id=evt-2145 applied on primary at 1998760000; last_replicated=1998760200 to replica-1, replica-2 replication_lag=420s.

support_lee: That matches the mixed success: some requests hit nodes that know the alias, others hit stale replicas. Two short-term fixes: 1) call the tool by canonical UUID (7f2b) until replication finishes, or 2) add a local fallback mapping in the client for `translate_text` -> `translate` while we patch replication.

customer_jess: How do we call by UUID? Any example?

devex_sam: Example: set `tool_id: \"7f2b\"` in the request instead of `tool_name`. Example request snippet:```json
{
  "tool_id": "7f2b",
  "args": {...}
}
```
This bypasses name-to-uuid lookup. Also you can reduce SDK cache TTL: `client.config.registry_ttl_seconds = 30`.

backend_maya: We'll kick a manual replication sync for replica-2 and monitor. Also opening an internal infra ticket to investigate why replication lag hit ~7 minutes during the rename window.

registry-bot: replication_sync job started for replica-2 at 1998766200.

support_lee: Once rep sync completes, let us know and we can confirm. For now, workaround = call by UUID or set local fallback alias mapping. Sorry for the disruption :thumbsup:

customer_jess: Thanks — switching to UUID fallback for now. If I see any further errors I'll re-open. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:

backend_maya: Follow-up note for the ops runbook: when performing renames, publish alias backfills and monitor replica_lag > 60s. Will add a pre-check step.

support_lee: Adding ops note to the incident checklist. Marking this thread resolved for support; ping if it recurs. :white_check_mark:
